kpi_specs.name: Total Sales Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Calculates the overall revenue generated across all invoices to measure the platform's financial performance.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_revenue FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: A single total revenue card is the primary high-level metric for any commerce dashboard, highlighting overall business scale.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpi_specs.description: Tracks the total invoice amounts grouped by year and month to identify seasonal trends and growth rates.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS sales_month, SUM(Total) AS monthly_revenue FROM data GROUP BY sales_month ORDER BY sales_month ASC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A line chart is the ideal visual pattern for analyzing financial performance and transactional trends over a chronological timeline.

kpi_specs.name: Revenue by Billing Country
kpi_specs.description: Compares gross sales across different countries to pinpoint key regional markets.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS country_revenue FROM data GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY country_revenue DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A bar chart highlights the geographical dispersion of sales, enabling easy comparison of core market revenues.

kpi_specs.name: Top Primary Artists by Tracks Sold
kpi_specs.description: Ranks the primary artists whose music has been purchased the most, based on total tracks sold.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT primary_artist, SUM(track_count) AS total_tracks_sold FROM data GROUP BY primary_artist ORDER BY total_tracks_sold DESC LIMIT 10

kpi_specs.name: Top Customers and Purchase Metrics

kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(InvoiceId) AS purchase_frequency, SUM(Total) AS total_spent, AVG(distinct_tracks_purchased) AS avg_distinct_tracks FROM data GROUP BY CustomerId ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 15
